BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat York!!
Woo hoo hoo!! I've never seen such a big crysta!\nIt's really a treasure!
Oh, thank god!
Argh?!
You belong to Pax faction, don't you?!\nWhy are you dealing with Lyark's property?!
Show yourself, York!!
How did you know?
Look at this...
It was near the wizard cannon.\nAnd in the crysta factory above.
Mondan told you to be careful about it, right?\nYou should've listen to her advice...
I had to accept her arrogant attitude?!\nShe's just good at magic but she's younger than me!\nHow could I listen to her?!
I couldn't use magic since childhood.\nSo, I've been developing my skill as a engineer...
But Pax Technista's technology is no longer\ninseparable from magic, so I felt inferior...
Remember the battle wasteland in the suburb of\nEl Scaro?
At that moment, I was shocked to see the difference\nin power between us, and my heart was completely\nbroken...
You and Yarn said that I can't use magic.\nI couldn't stand it and I ran away.\nThen, I met that person...
That person told me about the wizard cannon that\ncan be used without magic!!
Who's that person?
Coenubia...
C-Coenubia?? Who's that?\nStrange name.
...Coenubia introduced me to the Lyark researchers\nwho are excavating and restoring the wizard cannon.
Plus, allowed me to help me restore it and create\nhuge crystals... I made this wizard launcher with\nthe knowledge that I've learned from them.
Lyark can create such strong weapons without using\nunsure and unstable magic stuffs.\nSo, I should fit Lyark... So, I...
Hey! You're gonna betray your fellows?!\nYou've been working with them for a long time,\nright?!
Everytime I do something, they make fun of me\njust because I can't use magic!\nI just can't stand it any more!!
I think you guys were a good team.
Even though Yarn and Mondan say that you can't\nuse magic...
I think they admit that you're skillful. Look,\nyou can utilize unknown technology in a short\nperiod of time and create such a great stuff.
They don't know it, right?\nThen, you can go back to the team again.
Heh... Coenubia, I'm no longer useful, huh?
Aggghhh! What should we do?!\nWhat should we dooooo?!
What?!
Go now. It will collapse again...
Come with us! It's dangerous there!!
A betrayer was betrayed now...\nIt serves me right, heh...
Yooooork!!
